opportunities.title: Great Britain Sasakawa Foundation Small Grants

amount.raw: Typically £1,500‑£5,000 per grant; exceptional awards may exceed £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that can receive grant funds; individuals are not eligible unless they can provide organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for UK‑Japan collaborative projects across arts, culture, humanities, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport, enabling events, exchanges, collaborative outputs, teaching, and academic research.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: Up to £10,000 per year; up to £30,000 total for projects lasting up to three years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; practitioners, managers, carers and early‑career researchers are welcomed, especially those without prior UK‑Japan collaboration experience.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in the UK and Japan, covering scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare; grants may fund travel, conference, and publication costs.
